thread:
Ravi Kapoor: Hi all, day 1 for me in infra. PR smoke job fails because it tries to flip a staging flag but I don't have Console access. Who should I ping for short-lived CI creds?
Maya Lopez: Welcome Ravi! :wave: Eng-infra handles short-lived service accounts. For staging flag flips you either get a SA + Vault token or we ask you to use the `ff-test/*` namespace if it's ephemeral.
Ravi Kapoor: Where do I request the SA? Any template for justification?
onboard-bot: Please open an access request: https://redwood.internal/access-requests. Choose "Console service account (staging)" and include manager approval. Typical justification: "CI smoke tests need to toggle staging flags for PR validation".
Jules Park: Tip: specify exact job name and flag keys in the form. We prefer 30d keys for CI. Also we attach a minimal policy like `console.flags.write` scoped to the staging org.
Ravi Kapoor: Cool. I'll try `ff-test/*` first. If that's insufficient I'll file the request and ping here.
infra-bot: Draft secret path created: secret/data/ci/console/sa-2026-537 (awaiting upload).
Maya Lopez: Ping me after you submit and I'll fast-track approval for staging-only access.
Ravi Kapoor: Submitted request: https://redwood.internal/access-requests/req-2026-537. Thanks everyone!
Jules Park: I'll create the SA and post the Vault snippet once infra uploads the token. Expect ~48h.
Ravi Kapoor: Thanks — appreciate the quick help.
Maya Lopez: Welcome aboard again! If you want a 10m Console flags walkthrough later I can run through test namespaces and the admin panel.
Ravi Kapoor: Yes please, 3pm PT works for me.
